passages.title: Flow and Rhythm
passages.text: In the modern software landscape, precision and rhythm determine cognitive flow. Mastering the keyboard without looking down transforms the computer into a natural extension of the mind, allowing ideas to move directly onto the screen without friction or hesitation.

passages.title: Deliberate Muscle Memory
passages.text: Consistent daily practice builds durable finger pathways far faster than occasional marathon drills. When accuracy leads the way, speed emerges naturally as keystrokes blend into smooth multi-letter rhythms across every row.

passages.title: Quiet Focus
passages.text: Calm attention keeps errors low and reduces unnecessary tension in the shoulders and wrists. Breathe evenly, keep your eyes on the upcoming word, and trust your home-row anchors to guide each reach back to center.
